steers.title: 7 recent losses look like wrong-side trades
steers.detail: Multiple losses >2% of position suggest we're fading momentum. Check if signals are aligned with trend.

deep_analysis:
FLAT, and that is currently the right call. Zero open positions while the tape pays neither side at mid-band.

Market shape: BTC is +0.09% over 24h and +2.04% over 7d, yet sits below EMA300 for ~8 straight hours with bearish linreg on 1m/5m/15m/1h and Wyckoff MARKDOWN — a low-volume, low-volatility grind downward inside a flat week. 120 of 129 tokens read SHORT_BIAS on the 15m scanner. This is chop inside a markdown, not a trend worth chasing in either direction.

Both sides are bleeding: last 7d LONG 120T 40.0% WR -$2.19, SHORT 39T 25.6% WR -$1.07. Last 24h we took 29 LONG vs 4 SHORT (87% long) in a tape where nearly every token is SHORT_BIAS and BTC is under EMA300 — 33 trades, ~39% WR, -$0.77. We were structurally on the wrong side: the winning side for those long losers was short or flat.

Shorts are not the answer either as currently fired: 4/4 shorts lost in 24h, and 7d SHORT RSI 40-50 = 11T 0% WR -$0.80. pump-chain- shorts fire after the dump has happened and get ATR-stopped on the bounce. Mid-band entries lose on BOTH sides — only extremes and trend-continuation entries pay.

What actually wins (7d exit families): trail family = profit-monster-trail 37T 89.2% +$1.68 plus atr_trail_hit 11T 72.7% +$1.45 (48T, +$3.13). Chop exits = atr_sl_hit 48T 2.1% -$3.41 + hard_max_loss 21T 0% -$2.56 + trail_arm_timeout 10T 10% -$0.52 + stale_exit 3T 0% -$0.62 (82T, -$7.11). Trades that never reach the +0.40% trail-arm level never win. We make money only when a move is real enough to trail.

Best available posture: stay flat until either (a) volume expands and a continuum-trend+ entry appears (only green signal family with n>=5: 5T 80% WR +$0.09), or (b) an extreme-band setup appears. Do not re-enter mid-band bounce longs — that is the single biggest bleed cell we have.
regime_context:
Regime: BEAR-GRIND / CHOP. btc_15m SHORT_BIAS, btc_4h LONG_BIAS, continuum BELOW EMA300 (480+ consecutive ticks), linreg BEAR on every timeframe, zscore STRONG_NEG, Wyckoff MARKDOWN, but volume LOW and volatility LOW — slow markdown, not capitulation. Auto-trader independently scores long -40 / short +20, regime CHOP, decision BRACKET; its one shadow trade (CHOP, long) lost -0.25%.

Implication for positions: with 0 open we carry zero directional risk — correct for this regime. The danger is re-entry, not exposure. The 15m SHORT_BIAS consensus (120/129) makes counter-trend LONGs low-probability, but the LOW volume also means shorts get bounced out mid-band (verified: 7d SHORT 40-50 RSI = 0% WR). Neither side pays at the center of the range.

Flip watch: btc_4h is still LONG_BIAS and BTC is +2% on 7d. If BTC reclaims EMA300 (~84.0k) with volume, the entire alt tape flips LONG_BIAS fast — do not be short into that. Conversely a volume expansion below 82.8k opens real downside and would finally make short-bias entries worth taking.
pattern_alerts:
VERIFIED patterns (PostgreSQL, 2026-10-22, meta_rsi used — never entry_rsi_14):

1) OVER-LONG IN A BEAR TAPE (24h, n=33): LONG 29T 44.8% WR avg -$0.017 (-$0.50); SHORT 4T 0% WR avg -$0.068 (-$0.27). 87% of trades were LONG while 120/129 tokens were SHORT_BIAS and BTC sat below EMA300. WINNING SIDE: short or flat — the market kept grinding down (POL -4.9%, STX -4.9%, INJ -3.7%, SYRUP -3.1% were all longs). WHY WE WEREN'T ON IT: signal stream is long-heavy (bb-bounce-v2-long+, r2v2-long*, ichimoku+) and fires on bounces inside the downtrend.

2) MID-BAND LONG BLEED (7d, n=48): LONG meta_rsi 50-60 = 35.4% WR, -$2.21 total, avg -$0.046 — the single largest loss cell in the book. WINNING SIDE: LONG at meta_rsi 60+ = 42T +$0.91 (the only green long band) or no trade at all. WHY: bounce signals (bb-bounce-v2-long+, continuation+, doji-bottom-long) fire precisely at 50-60 RSI. Contrast: bb-bounce-v2-long+ 21T 47.6% -$0.60, doji-bottom-long 11T 45.5% -$0.51.

3) SHORTING THE MIDDLE AFTER THE DUMP (7d, n=11): SHORT meta_rsi 40-50 = 0% WR, -$0.80, avg -$0.073. pump-chain- family: 10T 0% WR -$0.58 (7d) — worst signal family by PnL with n>=5. WINNING SIDE: the bounce — intraday price rallied against every one of these entries (CFX/CRV/COMP all atr_sl_hit at entry RSI 51-59). WHY: pump-chain- triggers after the impulse already happened, so the short enters mid-range and eats the retrace.

4) CHOP EXITS vs TRAIL EXITS (7d, n=130): hard_max_loss 21T 0% WR -$2.56; atr_sl_hit 48T 2.1% WR -$3.41; trail_arm_timeout 10T 10% -$0.52; stale_exit 3T 0% -$0.62 — combined 82T -$7.11. Meanwhile profit-monster-trail 37T 89.2% +$1.68 and atr_trail_hit 11T 72.7% +$1.45 — combined 48T +$3.13 (83% WR). WINNING SIDE: trend continuation big enough to trail. WHY NOT US: entries made during chop never reach +0.40% to arm the trail, so they can only lose. Trend is your friend until it ends — but in chop there is no trend to befriend.

5) SIGNAL FAMILIES TO STARVE (7d, n>=5, all negative): pump-chain- 10T 0% -$0.58 | bb-bounce-v2-long+ 21T 47.6% -$0.60 | ai-trader+ 14T 42.9% -$0.54 | doji-bottom-long 11T 45.5% -$0.51 | pump-chain+ 21T 19.0% -$0.26 | ai-trader-pending 10T 10% -$0.28 | hl_copy_trader 6T 16.7% -$0.20. Only green family n>=5: continuum-trend+ 5T 80% +$0.09.
